newsitem.title: USA: Hints of inflation lurking in Feb U.S. NAPM report.
newsitem.headline: Hints of inflation lurking in Feb U.S. NAPM report.

text.p: Seizing on solid gains in the the prices paid and supplier deliveries components of the February National Association of Purchasing Management report, economists grew wary once again about an otherwise benign U.S. inflation environment.

Many cautioned however, that it was too early to get overly concerned about inflation bottlenecks and any subsequent rise in U.S. interest rates, despite warnings about preemptive tightening in Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's recent Congressional testimony.
